Name: Bartholomew
Summary: Bartholomew, often identified with Nathanael, was an apostle praised by Jesus as a true Israelite in whom there was no deceit. He came to faith after Philip invited him to come and see Jesus.
KeyStory: Jesus told Nathanael he had seen him under the fig tree before Philip called him, and Nathanael declared, You are the Son of God.
LifeLesson: Jesus saw Nathanael in his private place under the fig tree before anyone called him. You are seen and known by Jesus in your unseen places today.
